details: @galicia-toolkit/error-master@999.0.3 claims the `@galicia-toolkit` scope and describes itself as a dependency-confusion PoC. Its postinstall hook runs on npm install using `node postinstall.js || true` and sends encoded hostname, working-directory, platform, runtime-version, and username data as DNS labels to `oob.s4yhii.com`, making it a dependency-confusion probe that collects environment data. The npm account s4yhii_ published it on 2026-10-08.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
